summary: Retest of iteration_1 fixes for SIDATA Bappeda Makassar. Backend: 36/36 pytest cases pass against the PUBLIC URL, including new SSE streaming tests for POST /api/ai/analyze (all 5 kategori city-wide + per-kecamatan Tallo), ObjectId guards, petugas wilayah scoping (403/200), and register role-escalation guard. Frontend: /analisa-ai city-wide streams progressively (first content <5s, 4 markdown h2 rendered, elapsed timer during load, ai-speak appears after done), simulated 500 shows ai-error + ai-retry-btn and retry succeeds for Kecamatan Tallo. Regression pass: Dashboard 6 KPI + 16 charts, Peta 15 markers + region-detail + 5 category buttons + ranking, Aksesibilitas Tunanetra/Tunarungu cards + POST /api/tts 200, admin login -> nav-input -> DataEntry PUT 200 + success toast + restore, logout hides nav-input, a11y toggles apply a11y-large/a11y-contrast/a11y-reduce-motion classes. No blockers found.

minor.issue: SSE stream always returns HTTP 200 even when the LLM call fails (error is emitted as a 'data: {"error":...}' event). Acceptable for SSE, but clients must parse the error event - documented; frontend handles it.

Still publicly open (role is correctly downgraded to petugas, verified downgraded user gets 403 editing another kecamatan). Test-created user TEST_qa_*@example.com remains in DB - no delete endpoint exists for cleanup.

ui_bugs.issue: Sonner toast (top-right) overlaps the header 'Masuk Petugas' / user+Keluar area, briefly covering those controls.
Still no data-testid on the 4 'Fitur Utama' cards (carried over from iteration_1).

issues: Recurring React dev warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option> ... hydration error' from the dev instrumentation wrapper; non-blocking.
Expected 401 on /api/auth/me for public visitors logged as console errors.

action_items: Optional: restrict POST /api/auth/register to admins (role escalation is fixed, but self-signup is still open) and add cleanup/delete for users.
Optional: offset the toast container so it does not overlap the header login/logout controls.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ai_analyze: DB insert of the full result is wrapped in a bare 'except Exception: pass' - failures are silently swallowed; log at warning level.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan handlers.
AIAnalysis.js: the catch block collapses all failures into one generic Indonesian message; consider surfacing the SSE 'error' payload for diagnosability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -q. AI endpoint is SSE - use the consume_sse() helper in backend_test.py (aggregates 'delta' events, expects 'done'). Frontend testids verified: ai-page, ai-kategori, ai-wilayah, ai-analyze-btn, ai-result, ai-error, ai-retry-btn, ai-speak; map-page, map-cat-<field> are BUTTONS (not a select) inside div[data-testid=map-category-selector], region-detail, map-ranking; login-email/password/submit, nav-input, field-<key>, save-btn, logout-btn; a11y-text-size/contrast-toggle/motion-toggle. Marker click target: '.leaflet-container path.leaflet-interactive'.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous 502 root cause (60s ingress cutoff on a single long AI response) is resolved by StreamingResponse SSE with X-Accel-Buffering: no - first bytes arrive in ~2-5s so the ingress keeps the connection open; verified via the public URL for all 5 kategori and per-kecamatan. The 2 test failures in this iteration's first run were test-code defects (invalid .test email domain and wrong field name 'nama' instead of 'name' in the register payload) and were fixed in backend_test.py.
